items.post_title_orig: I’m sure there is no shortage of misheard lyrics for PJ but…
items.post_selftext:
For me, it’s from Wishlist:
 Misheard Lyric: “I wish I was a silhouette - someone who waited for me”
 Correct Lyric: “I wish I was a sailor with someone who waited for me”
 I don’t really know why I prefer my version better, God knows it makes no sense, but I always thought it sounded cool. 
    submitted by    /u/EricAnn
